characters.name: Bobo
characters.title: The Brave Bunny
characters.description: Curious, kind and always ready to turn a little question into a big adventure.

characters.name: Ollie
characters.title: The Playful Octopus
characters.description: Bubbly, funny and full of wild ideas. Ollie can find a new game in almost anything.

characters.name: Coco
characters.title: The Cozy Capy
characters.description: Calm, caring and everyone's best friend. Coco always makes room for one more.
characters.catchphrase: There's always room for a friend.

characters.name: Tilly
characters.title: The Curious Turtle
characters.description: Thoughtful, clever and happiest when learning something new with a friend.

characters.name: Mimi
characters.title: The Magic Mushroom
characters.description: Creative, cheerful and always ready to add a little sparkle to an ordinary day.
